source_math_findings: Envelope Jacobi normalization and first/second rho derivatives agree with the channel solid-harmonic radial mass; common nodes carry an invertible full channel map and do not assert diagonal common mass.

Segmented quadrature integrates the same .5 sqrt(rho) d(rho) radial measure, with Jacobi treatment at zero and Legendre panels at fixed geometry/gauge/symmetrizer endpoints. It changes integration only.

The extended fit includes raw22 values and eleven configuration radial derivatives, plus independent first-envelope-derivative output columns. Core replacement uses C0_rho, C0+C1_rho, C1+C2_rho consistently; configuration rows require no third input-envelope derivative.

Actual normalized-source held-out fitting checks complete Ut,DsUt,Vt. Reference normalization retains the A-trace tangent coupling through the captured raw field/source lift. It does not differentiate momentum evolution.

Y=(q,V), q=c Ur, DsY=(c(cr Ur+c Urr),c Vr), dV=(r^2/c)dr dOmega and dSigma=rb^2 dOmega are consistent. Origin surface terms vanish for the regular solid-envelope fields; no origin boundary data are imposed.
Strong K pairs the point source with the energy test map; weak K integrates only the q_t=DsUt term by parts and retains the correct div_s=2c/r and rb^2 outer term.
G independently uses R=Yt-Kn DsY, Gamma=Ds(HKn)+(2c/r)HKn and the symmetric U Ut mass contribution. Missing coefficient derivatives are not hidden by deriving G from a matrix residual.

H_C=Lc^T Lc is analytic in positive alpha and the admitted cutoff branch; algebraic transpose in complex-step differentiation is correct. H_D blending is restricted to Wgauge=1. Screen rotations use the same nonorthonormal STF chart.

SAT=-kin B^T H Pplus B, B=rb sqrt(wangle)Y, with positive incoming kin for RHS y_t=Kn y_r, has the declared adjoint sign. The forcing is assembled from pointwise (Y-Yt)X and (U-Ut)X before matrix solves, while prescribed incoming data gives boundaryload=-SAT X.

Weak/strong, volume and manufactured tests are non-tautological integration-by-parts/coefficient checks: the preserved global quadrature failures occur despite point-forcing consistency with strong K. E_nodal congruence, by contrast, is an algebraic conversion readback and not an independently assembled nodal mass certificate.
limitations: Source review and saved-array checks do not independently reproduce the actual point kernel; existing pinned local source/angular/core gates supply that binding.
The fixed radial symmetrizer and measured incoming sector ranks do not establish all-direction symmetrization, constraint-preserving boundary conditions, exact-scri closure or PDE stability.
This is fixed J0,N8,rb.98 evidence. J1/J2, physical constraint rates and degree/radius controls require their own gates.
Generalized symmetric energy production and trace norms are finite-dimensional diagnostics, distinct from generator spectra or nonlinear pulse/BH acceptance.
